name: com.filloprinci.retrofpa
description: Reusable runtime and editor toolkit for building retro low-poly (PS1/N64/GameCube-era) first-person horror/adventure games in Unity. Provides decoupled managers, data-driven ScriptableObjects, ready-to-place prefabs, and editor tooling (dialogue/item authoring, validators).

samples.description: NpcBase (Animator + shared placeholder AnimatorController with an AnimatorOverrideController slot) and WorldItemBase (Physical/Pickupable variants), ready to import and use as a starting point.
